name: Electricity Transformer Temperature (ETT) Dataset
description: A multivariate time-series dataset for long-term forecasting, containing electricity load and oil temperature measurements from electricity transformers. It is provided in four subsets: ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, and ETTm2, at hourly and 15-minute resolutions.
citation: Z Zhou, S. Zhang, J. Wang, S. Sun, Z. Li, and Z. Xu. (2021). Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting. Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 35(12), 11106–11115. https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v35i12.17325
